steps.description: The public menu, seeded at install with the pages churchit ships: Home, Beliefs, Sermons, Missions, Ministries, Calendar, About, Contact, Give. It is yours from then on; nothing rewrites it. Removing a link here leaves its Web Page published, so churchit offers to unpublish the page when you save.
